fetch_message_details.description: Look up the delivery status and details of a message you sent or received, including why it failed if it did not go through.

mock_response.body: Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at 2pm.

fetch_message_details.name: fetch_message_details

parameters.description: The unique ID of the message to look up (starts with SM). You get this back when you send a message.
parameters.name: message_sid

body.description: The text content of the message, or empty if the message carries only media.

date_sent.description: When Twilio sent the message, or empty if it has not been sent yet.

error_message.description: A description of what went wrong if the message failed, or empty if there was no error.

from.description: The phone number the message was sent from.

message_status.description: Where the message is in delivery, such as queued, sending, sent, delivered, undelivered, or failed.

sid.description: The unique ID of the message.

to.description: The phone number the message was sent to.

get_call.description: Look up a phone call: whether it was answered, how long it lasted, and when it started and ended.
get_call.name: get_call

parameters.description: The unique ID of the call to look up (starts with CA). You get this back when you make a call.
parameters.name: call_sid

call_status.description: Where the call is: queued, ringing, in-progress, completed (answered and ended), busy, no-answer, failed, or canceled.

duration_seconds.description: How long the call lasted, in seconds, or empty until it ends.

end_time.description: When the call ended, or empty while it's going on.

from.description: The phone number the call came from.

sid.description: The unique ID Twilio gave the call (starts with CA).

start_time.description: When the call was answered, or empty if it wasn't.

to.description: The phone number that was called.

list_messages.description: List your recent text messages, newest first. You can narrow the results to a specific recipient or sender.

make_call.description: Call a phone number from your Twilio number and read out a message in a computer voice, then hang up.
make_call.name: make_call

parameters.description: The phone number to call, including the country code (for example, +15551234567).
parameters.name: to_number

parameters.description: Your Twilio phone number to call from. It's the number the person sees. Beta: leave it blank to call from your account's own number. That works when the account has exactly one number that can make calls; with several, or none, the step stops without calling and asks for one to be chosen here. To choose, pick one of your numbers or type one in +15551234567 format.
parameters.name: from_number

parameters.description: What to say when the call is answered. It's read out once, so put the most important part first.
parameters.name: message

call_status.description: Where the call is when it starts, usually queued. Use 'Get call details' to see how it ended.

from.description: The phone number the call came from.

sid.description: The unique ID Twilio gave the call (starts with CA).

to.description: The phone number that was called.

send_sms.description: Send a text (SMS) message to a phone number from your Twilio phone number or messaging service.
send_sms.name: send_sms

parameters.description: The phone number to text, including the country code (for example, +15551234567).
parameters.name: to_number

parameters.description: Your Twilio phone number to send from. Beta: leave it blank to send from your account's own number. That works when the account has exactly one number that can text; with several, or none, the step stops without sending and asks for one to be chosen here. To choose, pick one of your numbers, or type a number in +15551234567 format or a Messaging Service SID (starts with MG).
parameters.name: from_number

parameters.description: The text of the message to send.
parameters.name: body

from.description: The phone number or messaging service the message was sent from.

message_status.description: Where the message is in delivery, such as queued, sending, sent, delivered, or failed.

sid.description: The unique ID Twilio assigned to this message (starts with SM).

to.description: The phone number the message was sent to.

send_whatsapp.description: Send a WhatsApp message from your WhatsApp-enabled Twilio number. WhatsApp delivers a message you write yourself only to someone who messaged that number in the last 24 hours.
send_whatsapp.name: send_whatsapp

parameters.description: The person's WhatsApp phone number, including the country code (for example, +15551234567).
parameters.name: to_number

parameters.description: Your Twilio number that's set up for WhatsApp (in +15551234567 format), or a Messaging Service SID (starts with MG) that includes it.
parameters.name: from_number

parameters.description: The text of the message to send.
parameters.name: body

from.description: The WhatsApp number or messaging service it was sent from.

message_status.description: Where the message is in delivery, such as queued, sent, delivered, read, or failed.

sid.description: The unique ID Twilio assigned to this message (starts with SM).

to.description: Who it was sent to, as whatsapp: and their number.

description: Send text messages and make phone calls that read out a message, then check how each one went, with Twilio.

twilio_new_incoming_call_trigger.description: Runs when a phone call to one of your Twilio numbers ends, with who called, whether it was answered and how long it lasted. Calls that ended before the workflow was turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.call_status: How it ended: completed (answered), busy, no-answer, failed, or canceled (hung up before it was answered).
output.caller_name: The caller's name, when caller name lookup is turned on for your number.
output.duration_seconds: How long the call lasted, in seconds.
output.sid: The call's unique ID (starts with CA).
output.start_time: When the call was answered, if it was.

parameters.description: Only calls to this number, such as +15551234567. Leave blank for calls to any of your numbers.
parameters.name: to_number

twilio_new_incoming_message_trigger.description: Runs for each text message someone sends to one of your Twilio numbers, with who sent it and what it says. Messages already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.from: The phone number that sent it.
output.num_media: How many pictures or files came with it.
output.sid: The message's unique ID (starts with SM or MM).
output.to: Your Twilio number it was sent to.

parameters.description: Only messages sent to this number, such as +15551234567. Leave blank for messages to any of your numbers.
parameters.name: to_number

twilio_new_recording_trigger.description: Runs when a new recording of a call or voicemail is ready in your Twilio account, with the address of its audio. Recordings already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.audio_url: The address of the recording's audio as an MP3, to download or pass to a transcription step.
output.call_sid: The ID of the call it recorded (starts with CA).
output.duration_seconds: How long the recording is, in seconds.
output.sid: The recording's unique ID (starts with RE).
